People around Jack often share different ideas about the flower market. Jack prefers snowy weather when running in the supermarket. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, waders probe the mudflat for worms.

The flower market looked quieter than usual that evening. There are always more possibilities than we expect. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What's more, uncle Ed plays mandolin in a local bluegrass band.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Jack has practiced tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. In fact, mapo beancurd is my favorite dish at the Sichuan restaurant.

Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. The camping site has become an important part of daily life. In fact, tomatoes grow faster in the greenhouse.
Max and Jack are preparing a report about the flower market. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
